outcome: Postpartum bleeding volume (2 and 12 hours postpartum)
cohort: A total of 200 parturients scheduled for cesarean sections at risk of postpartum hemorrhage.
finding: Intravenous remimazolam significantly reduced the incidence and severity of nausea and vomiting induced by carboprost tromethamine during cesarean section, and improved sedative effects and maternal satisfaction, without affecting Apgar scores or postpartum bleeding.
followup_time: Up to 12 hours postpartum, and 5 minutes after birth for Apgar scores, plus duration of postpartum bleeding.
